items.purpose: Establish the parties, procedural posture, and the core relief sought (specific performance vs. compensation).
items.relation_question: Who sued whom for what specific relief in the Civil Appeals of 1952?
items.limit: Does not establish the final outcome or validity of the claims.

items.purpose: Detail the prior lease history involving Kuchwar Co., including the prohibition on assignment and subsequent liquidation.
items.relation_question: What were the terms of the original 1928 lease to Kuchwar Co. and how did their interest transfer in 1933?
items.limit: Does not confirm whether the Government's forfeiture order was legally valid at that time.

items.purpose: Trace the formation of the alleged contract between Lime Co. and Defendant No. 1 (State of Bihar) via correspondence and offers.
items.relation_question: How did the Lime Co. apply for the lease and when did the Board of Revenue offer terms which were accepted?
items.attribution: Exhibits A, B, C / Trial Court Findings
items.limit: Does not address whether this agreement survived later legal challenges regarding title.

items.purpose: Describe the conflict with Kuchwar Co.'s reinstatement and the impact on Lime Co.'s possession.
items.relation_question: Did the High Court and Privy Council decisions favoring Kuchwar Co. oust the Lime Co. from possession before the current suit?
items.limit: Does not determine if the Lime Co. retained any equitable rights despite vacating possession.

items.purpose: Identify the trigger for the current suit: refusal to execute leases and grant to Defendant No. 2.
items.relation_question: When did Defendant No. 1 refuse to execute the agreed leases and instead lease to Dalmia Jain & Co.?
items.limit: Does not validate the claim that a binding contract existed at that moment.

items.purpose: Outline Defendant No. 1's defenses regarding contract formation, negotiation status, and procedural bars.
items.relation_question: On what grounds did the State of Bihar deny the existence of a concluded contract and raise pleas of limitation/waiver?
items.limit: These are party positions, not established facts.

items.purpose: Outline Defendant No. 2's defenses regarding lack of privity, notice, and subsequent lessee status.
items.relation_question: How did Dalmia Jain & Co. contest the right of Lime Co. to sue and claim protection as a bona fide purchaser/lessee?
items.limit: Does not resolve whether Defendant No. 2 had actual notice of the prior agreement.

items.purpose: Summarize the Trial Court's findings on contract existence, terms, and rejection of defenses.
items.relation_question: Did the Trial Court find a valid contract for a 20-year lease and reject pleas of estoppel and waiver?
items.limit: This finding was reversed by the High Court; it is not the final appellate position.

items.purpose: Detail the High Court's reversal based on mutual mistake of fact regarding title and statutory voidness.
items.relation_question: Why did the High Court hold the contract void under Section 20 ICA and Section 30 GOI Act despite agreeing a contract was made?
items.limit: The Supreme Court may review these legal conclusions; they are attributed findings, not final truth.

items.purpose: Address the procedural objection regarding the deletion of the 'mistake' issue and counsel's concession.
items.relation_question: Was the issue of mutual mistake deleted from the trial court issues, and did defendants concede no mistake was pleaded?
items.limit: Contradicts the High Court's reliance on mistake; requires reconciliation of record vs. judgment.

items.purpose: Examine the dispute over Specific Relief Act Section 15 (relinquishment of claims) and readiness/willingness.
items.relation_question: Did the Lime Co. properly relinquish claims for past damages to seek specific performance for future periods?
items.attribution: High Court Findings / Plaintiff's Application & Oral Arguments
items.limit: The adequacy of the relinquishment statement is a contested legal point.

items.purpose: Note the failure to produce draft leases despite court orders, impacting evidence availability.
items.relation_question: Were the draft leases produced by Defendant No. 1 during the trial proceedings?
items.limit: Non-production does not prove the contents of the drafts but affects evidentiary weight.

open_items: The Supreme Court's final reasoning on whether the High Court erred in applying Section 20 ICA given the trial court's issue framing.
Whether the Lime Co.'s oral clarification of relinquishment satisfied Section 15 SRA requirements in the eyes of the apex court.
The precise legal effect of the Privy Council's contempt ruling on the Lime Co.'s standing to claim restitution or specific performance.
